correctness.rationale: The arXiv:2506.18388v1 divisor-basis theorem identifies Cl(X_w)/Pic(X_w) as the cokernel of the exact integer Bruhat-cover coroot matrix and Q-factoriality as squareness. The standalone checker enumerates all 1,152 faithful F4 root matrices, independently confirms each length with the 24 positive roots, matches reduced-word-deletion covers with an enumeration by all 24 reflections for every element (6,168 total covers), and obtains Smith factors by exact gcds of all square minors. Output is 171 trivial, 49 cyclic order two, 13 (Z/2)^2, and 919 nonsquare. Explicit witnesses have matrices [[1,0],[1,2]] and [[1,0,0],[1,2,0],[1,2,2]]. No floating-point, sampling or unverified oracle is involved; the geometric link uses the cited published theorem.

value.rationale: The full integral Cartier defect (rather than merely rank) is a natural invariant in singular birational geometry. Type F4 is the smallest exceptional non-simply-laced Lie type, for which the general theorem explicitly leaves torsion phenomena open beyond individual examples. The exact 233 Q-factorial members, their multiplicity strata and the existence of 13 independent double two-torsion obstructions form a complete, usable finite classification that cannot be read off from rational cohomology ranks alone.
